title: Inversed Pebble watchface
symptom: In the latest release, the Pebble watchface 'Classic trend' has an inversed upper part (white background instead of black). The user asks if it is possible to switch it back to black background.
cause: The issue is caused by a setting in the watch face that controls whether the top and bottom background colors are the same. When this setting is not enabled, the top part appears white (inversed).
fix: In the watch face settings, turn on the option 'Same background colour top and bottom'. If it is already on, turn it off, save, then turn it on again. This should make the whole screen black background.
settings_changed: Same background colour top and bottom → on
evidence_quote: Once I had change the setting for Same background colour top and bottom, and saved it, the whole screen was black background.
